claim: [L167-L174] (MED/missing-assertion) test_rewind only asserts equality of array-name sets and prints numerical discrepancies, so arbitrarily different replay results still pass when the names match.
other_wording: [L167-L174] (MED/missing-assertion) The rewind comparison only prints numerical differences, so arbitrarily different restored results can pass the test.

claim: [L169-L173] (LOW/nonfinite-comparison) The difference threshold has no finite-value check, so NaN differences fail the greater-than comparison and are not even printed as discrepancies.
other_wording: [L169-L173] (MED/invalid-comparison) Empty ndarray values enter the scalar fallback and NaN differences fail the greater-than check, leaving these results without a reliable validation outcome.

claim: [L438,L539,L663,L785-L788] (MED/error-accounting) xshiftest resets errors before each subsequent datatype/rank variant without reporting the previous count, so its final total includes only the three-dimensional integer checks.
other_wording: [L339,L438,L539,L663,L785-L788] (MED/lost-error-count) xshiftest resets errors before each array type and rank, so the final reduced total includes only the last integer rank-three case.

claim: [L881-L882,L917-L918,L927,L937,L945-L946,L957] (MED/out-of-bounds) Non-master ranks allocate aa and iaa as 1-by-1 arrays and vvs with two elements but subsequently form full-domain sections of those arrays, violating their bounds even when the receiving routine ignores non-master send data.
other_wording: [L880-L883,L917-L918,L927,L937,L944-L947,L957] (MED/out-of-bounds-section) Non-master ranks allocate aa and iaa as 1-by-1 and vvs with two elements but pass global-sized sections of those arrays, exceeding their allocated bounds before any callee master guard applies.

claim: [L276-L278] (LOW/diagnostic) The vector-distribution failure message omits the i-1 offset from its printed expected value, so failures beyond the first element report the wrong expectation.
other_wording: [L276-L278] (LOW/misleading-diagnostic) The vector mismatch diagnostic prints fill1(is(rank+1)) instead of the indexed expected value actually used in the comparison.

claim: [L85-L110,L167-L170,L248-L254,L282-L288,L316-L322,L785-L792,L990-L992] (MED/failure-propagation) Detected numerical mismatches are only printed and never propagated to a program failure status, allowing an automated run to exit normally after failed checks.
other_wording: [L85-L110,L167,L248-L253,L282-L287,L316-L321,L785-L790,L990-L992] (MED/failure-propagation) Detected comparison failures are only printed and never propagated to a failing program exit status.

claim: [L878,L909-L913] (LOW/uninitialized-read) The master copies uninitialized a and ia into aa and iaa before scattertest initializes them, creating undefined reads even though the later scattertest overwrites the copied region.

[L13-L16,L25] (MED/working-directory) The script uses cd without /d and does not check whether it succeeded, so a solution on another drive or a missing directory leaves execution in the wrong working directory.
other_wording: [L13,L16,L23] (MED/unchecked-command-failure) The script runs the executable and opens the report without checking directory-change or launch success, allowing a failed invocation to display an old report.
